products.name: Bestway Cement (OPC 53 Grade)
products.description: Pakistan’s top choice for structural durability in mountain terrain. Fresh factory lift with guaranteed chemical composition.
products.specifications: ASTM C150 Type I / PS:232-2008, 28-day strength > 58 MPa
products.recommendedUse: High-altitude retaining walls, RCC roofs, bridges, columns & beams in Azad Kashmir

products.name: Fauji Cement (High-Early Strength)
products.description: Superior setting time designed for cold-weather mountain concreting and rapid strength gain.
products.specifications: Conforms to BS 12 & EN 197-1 CEM I 42.5R
products.recommendedUse: Cold-weather foundations, slab casting, and rapid cure concrete work

products.name: Askari Cement (Sulphate Resistant)
products.description: Engineered for tough soil chemistry, ground moisture exposure, and underground water reservoirs.
products.specifications: ASTM C150 Type V / Type I, High fineness & low heat hydration
products.recommendedUse: Ground retainers, basement drainage walls, underground water tanks in Sudhnoti

products.name: Cherat Cement (Pure Portland)
products.description: Smooth workability and consistent slump quality for plastering, brick masonry, and general slabs.
products.specifications: Low alkali formula, compressive strength 52 MPa at 28 days
products.recommendedUse: General masonry, plastering, slab casting, and boundary wall works

products.name: Deformed Steel Rebar (Grade 60)
products.description: Seismic-resistant reinforcement conforming to Azad Kashmir building codes. Guaranteed bendability and yield point.
products.specifications: ASTM A615 Grade 60, Yield Strength ≥ 60,000 PSI (420 MPa)
products.priceDisplay: Daily Mill Rate with Crane Offloading
products.recommendedUse: Earthquake-safe RCC structures, hillside cantilever slabs & columns

products.name: Margalla Hill Crushed Bajri & Chenab Sand
products.description: Clean, silt-free crushed rock aggregate quarried for maximum bond strength in concrete mixes.
products.specifications: 1/2" Down, 3/4" Down Aggregate & Coarse River Sand (< 3% silt)
products.imageAlt: Margalla crushed bajri and river sand
products.recommendedUse: RCC roof casting, lintels, concrete block manufacturing & plaster
